p10_b6.ocr: Additionally, the reported MAF in controls serves as a critical benchmark for understanding the prevalence of specific alleles within the population, which may have implications for pharmacogenetic responses in patients undergoing treatment. This analysis not only highlights the importance of genetic factors in clinical outcomes but also emphasizes the need for further investigation into the interplay between anticoagulant therapy and genetic predispositions.
